spans.s: tṛṣṇī (unrecorded) = tṛṣṇā, thirst, longing: tṛṣṇī-latā vichinnā LV 〔376.14〕 (vs); so Lefm. with best ms.; vv.ll. tṛṣṇā and dṛṣṭī (the latter clearly a rationalizing ‘correction’ of tṛṣṇī); tṛṣṇīyāḥ kāraṇābhiniveśaś ca Laṅk 〔179.3〕 (prose; no v.l.; Suzuki Transl. and Index em. tṛṣṇā). Cf. also Tantrī, perhaps pointing to an original Tṛṣṇī.
